title: Shiraishi An — Have No Regrets〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, what do you wanna do today?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sing, like we always do.
I'd rather not start getting all rusty.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I get that you wanna stay on top of your game, but we sing all the time. Don't you feel like doing something else?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Did you hear that voice just now?
I thought I heard someone sobbing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
I think I just heard it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But who would even be sobbing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it's not Miku or one of the others, it might be a ghost.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For now, let's head over towards where the voice is coming from.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I think it came from that way!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hurry, or we're gonna leave you behind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?! N-No!
Someone really is sobbing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Rin! Len!
What are you two doing on the ground?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have no idea, but we need to help them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't come any closer...
And whatever you do... Don't touch us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What...?!
We're not allowed to come over or touch you guys?! What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-What pain...?!
Wait, did you guys get cursed by something...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yesterday, we tried doing some of the exercises that Akito and his team did while they trained...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They were really hard, but we did our best. Unfortunately... Oww... We're sore everywhere now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys are just sore...
You had us going there for a second.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, seriously!
I totally thought you two got cursed or something!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... What should we do? We can't just leave them like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Having them rest at MEIKO's cafe seems ideal, but whether or not they can make it over will be up to them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right...
What would you two like us to do?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Owwwww! Wait! Stop!
You need to be more gentle! Ahhh!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You guys must be super sore...
Okay, we'll be really gentle...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry!
There, there. No more touching.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Carrying them in this state isn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Helping♪ Helping♪ I'm such a nice person♪ Delicious dessert and all the parfaits I want♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We can use that!
Luka, stop! Please come help us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hello!
We have a delivery for you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Along with Rin and Len♪
But they're apparently sore all over...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay...
I get the gist of what happened.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you all for bringing them over, An.
You can leave the boxes there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you have any drinks that will help us feel less sore, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, unfortunately...
But I feel like a cold compress would be the better choice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha. You two are really having a bad time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Akito, did you or the others not experience this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course we did.
But we didn't become completely paralyzed like them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? But you train and exercise regularly.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The workouts Haruka comes up with really are terrifying...
